items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: So an arrangement I wrote of the Band, the group the Band, Robbie Robertson and Michael — Richard Manuel.

ctx.x: In the 1950s they used sharp 9, it was a sharp nine chord I think. But it came out so smooth. I don’t think it was ever used in rock & roll before. And I did and I’m going is this okay with most of what I wrote. Totally naïve, and it became a number two. So you just follow your heart. And whenever I’ve tried to copy too much, do what I think is — it doesn’t happen. And then I do stuff that no one else has done. So getting back to your question, I was just thinking about this because I want to speak to these kids…
Oh yeah, it’s one of my favorites.
